title: Localization extension of the normalized section pullback comparison
statement: The ordinary section equation together with the derived computation equation on flat-term K-flat representatives extends to the all-complex SectionPullNormalized equation.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; localization descent in parent transport proof step 8.

proof_origin.place: Resolving-class descent from flat-term K-flat representatives.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration for this specialized quotient section model interface.

proof.text: View both sides of the derived computation equation as natural transformations on the derived category. The flat-term K-flat localization descent theorem gives equality on every object from equality on the resolving class.

lean.statement:
theorem section_pull_transport_extend_kflat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅
      derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T)
    (hflat : SectionPullNormalizedOnKFlat a f cX cY barLam) :
    SectionPullNormalized a f cX cY barLam
